newPage.n_festo_emmt_title: EMMT-AS — compact electric axis with integrated controller
newPage.n_festo_emmt_summary: Festo's EMMT-AS combines servo motor, drive stage and position sensor in one unit. Perfect for pick & place applications requiring precise control without a separate cabinet. Available in 28–58 mm flange sizes.
newPage.n_festo_vtux_title: VTUX-EM valve terminal with EtherNet/IP and PROFINET
newPage.n_festo_vtux_summary: The new VTUX valve terminal supports EtherNet/IP, PROFINET and IO-Link. Modular design allows up to 32 valve positions per terminal. Up to IP65/67 protection and -10 to +60 °C operating temperature.
newPage.n_smc_zp3_title: ZP3-TB vacuum pad series for electric drive systems
newPage.n_smc_zp3_summary: SMC's ZP3-TB series is designed for modern electric automation. Reduces compressed air consumption by up to 80% compared to traditional pneumatic systems. Available with M8 connection and integrated sensor.
newPage.n_smc_vqc_title: VQC series valves now with IO-Link 1.1
newPage.n_smc_vqc_summary: SMC's popular VQC 4/5-way valves are upgraded with IO-Link 1.1 support. Enables parameter control, diagnostics and cycle count monitoring directly from the PLC. Compatible with existing VQC manifolds.
newPage.n_parker_title: Parker P1D Series — smart cylinder with built-in position sensor
newPage.n_parker_summary: Parker expands the P1D ISO 15552 series with a smart sensor option. Magnetic position sensor with CANopen interface enables precise position control without an external sensor. Stroke 25–2000 mm, bore 32–125 mm.
newPage.n_bosch_title: ctrlX DRIVE — cabinet-free drive system for modern machines
newPage.n_bosch_summary: Bosch Rexroth's ctrlX DRIVE mounts directly on the motor, eliminating the need for a separate electrical cabinet. App-based software via ctrlX OS, support for EtherCAT and PROFINET. Reduces installation space by up to 50%.
newPage.n_norgren_title: Norgren V60 series — compact 5/2 valves for harsh environments
newPage.n_norgren_summary: The V60 series targets the food and automotive industries. IP67 protected, temperature resistant up to +70 °C and manufactured in corrosion-protected aluminium. Flow up to 760 Nl/min at 6 bar.
newPage.n_mw55_title: Metal Work Series 55 — ultra-compact cylinders for tight spaces
newPage.n_mw55_summary: Series 55 is Metal Work's answer to increasing demands for compact design. ISO 21287 cylinders with bore 12–63 mm and stroke up to 200 mm. Double-acting with magnetic piston as standard, built-in cushioning optional.
newPage.n_mwfix_title: Multifix valve islands with Ethernet connectivity
newPage.n_mwfix_summary: Metal Work's Multifix valve island is updated with EtherNet/IP and Modbus TCP. Up to 24 valve stations per unit, integrated pressure transducer card and diagnostic functions via web interface.
newPage.v_festo_desc: See how Festo combines bioinspired technology with industrial automation for the smart factories of the future.
newPage.v_bosch_desc: Introduction to ctrlX AUTOMATION — the open app-based system that simplifies machine automation with EtherCAT and cabinet-free solutions.
newPage.v_smc_desc: Technical overview of SMC's pneumatic and electric components — cylinders, valves, vacuum systems and IO-Link solutions.
newPage.v_parker_desc: Parker Hannifin's widest range of motion control — hydraulics, pneumatics and electric actuators for industrial automation.
newPage.v_mw_desc: Metal Work's complete range of pneumatic valves, cylinders and valve terminals for modern industrial automation.
newPage.n_camozzi_series_9_summary: Series 63 is Camozzi's ISO 15552-compliant cylinder range, with bores from 32 to 125 mm in both single- and double-acting versions. Widely used across transportation, printing and woodworking industries.
newPage.v_camozzi_desc: Camozzi's complete range of pneumatic cylinders, valves, FRL units and electric actuators for industrial automation.
